purpose: Receiving-agent checklist and installation record; populate from this host and selected projects, then perform the work. This is not an automatically executed controller schema.

pathPolicy.nativePackages: Use the internal distro package manager and its package-owned paths, including /usr/bin where declared.
pathPolicy.pythonLibraries: Distro Python packages through the distro package manager, or a dedicated virtual environment's site-packages; never copy libraries to /usr/bin.
pathPolicy.osPython: Inspect ownership, consumers and supported distro mechanisms before any necessary update; no blind /usr/bin/python3 replacement.
pathPolicy.symlinks: Inspect and record the prior destination; validate the new target; use a recoverable atomic update only for locally managed links.
pathPolicy.containerDependencies: Qualify separately from host dependencies in the actual worker image/service context.

capabilities.name: git
capabilities.acceptance: Resolve the real executable and access an authorized internal smoke repository without exposing credentials.

capabilities.name: transfer_archive_checksums
capabilities.acceptance: Verify the kit and a staged internal artifact using approved CA/authentication; exercise required archive formats.

capabilities.name: source_search_json
capabilities.acceptance: Search and parse a small local fixture from a fresh shell and the relevant worker context.

capabilities.name: python
capabilities.acceptance: Record the chosen interpreter; run controller prerequisites and representative project imports from their actual environments.

capabilities.name: node
capabilities.acceptance: Use a version compatible with the selected source/project requirements and prove native/runtime dependencies; preserve any adequate existing Node installation.

capabilities.name: container_runtime
commands: docker compose or an explicit selected Compose executable
capabilities.acceptance: Use the selected local socket and immutable images; qualify required Docker/Compose capabilities without disturbing other workloads.

capabilities.name: existing_internal_agent
commands: omp or claude, according to the existing working installation
capabilities.acceptance: Preserve or deliberately migrate the working configuration; complete a bounded internal-model invocation from the real host launcher.

capabilities.name: project_build_tools
capabilities.acceptance: Populate from project lockfiles/build instructions; install required package managers, compilers, test tools and native libraries from internal sources first, then execute representative builds/tests.
